pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries on the upper neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more rounded sub-ovoid shapes on the flank. Edges show moderate pixel-level blur with no sharp geometric angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous network of interconnected pathways with variable thickness. Junction nodes primarily feature trivalent intersections, maintaining a consistent topological flow across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour. The silhouette is composed of short, dark bristles that create a fuzzy interface with the background greenery.

other_distinctive_markers: Two avian subjects (likely oxpeckers) are perched on the upper neck region, partially occluding the mane and underlying pelage.
